issues.title: [Studio] Default privileges state misses grants made TO PUBLIC
issues.note:
Bug report: Studio's default-privileges state query misses grants made TO PUBLIC. The EXISTS subquery in `getDefaultPrivilegesStateSql` uses an INNER JOIN with `pg_roles`, which drops rows where `grantee = 0` (PUBLIC). Since PUBLIC covers anon/authenticated/service_role, grants to PUBLIC are invisible, making `grant_count` incorrectly return 0. The query needs a LEFT JOIN and `or acl.grantee = 0` to include PUBLIC grants.

Area: pg-meta / Studio default privileges.
